issues.description: The header declaration of ray_sphere_intersect in the template repository declares only three parameters (origin, dir, center) but the implementation and its call sites use four parameters (origin, dir, center, radius). The solution repository's header shows the correct four-parameter prototype. This mismatch between the template header and implementation/call sites will cause compilation errors or confusing compiler diagnostics and blocks students from building and testing the program.

The function ray_sphere_intersect is declared with different parameter lists between the template header and the implementation/solution: the template header omits the 'radius' parameter while the implementation (and the solution header) expects a 'radius' (const float). This mismatch makes it unclear to students which function signature to use and may lead to confusion when mapping the header declaration to the implementation or when calling the function.
issues.suggestedFix: Update the template header declaration in example_program/src/ray_sphere_intersect.h to include the 'radius' parameter (const float radius) so the header matches the implementation and the solution. Example: bool ray_sphere_intersect(const float *origin, const float *dir, const float *center, const float radius);
